name: search-marginalia
description: Marginalia Search adapter (SRC-15, EXT-01) — the R-16 structural lever: a second provider whose recall covers the query classes the MediaWiki search API ranking structurally misses (live-verified 2026-09-15: Everest-class pages at ranks 1-5 for the raw tallest-mountain question). Default path is the verified keyless legacy endpoint (api.marginalia.nu); an optional `config.apiKeySecret` names a secret (never the key) that switches to the keyed api2 endpoint (api2.marginalia-search.com, `API-Key` header) when one is obtainable — Marginalia's personal-key programme is closed as of 2026-09-21, recorded in plans/sources.md. Zero capabilities. Activation is terms-gated: config must name the dated plans/sources.md entry that clears this source. Result metadata is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (non-commercial research tool; linked pages carry their own licenses); the evidence store preserves attribution.
